newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair Nov load factor rises to 68.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swissair Nov load factor rises to 68.8 pct.

text.p: Swissair AG said its load factor rose to 68.8 percent in November from 67.7 percent in November last year. Swissair gave following details:
Total load factor 68.8 pct vs 67.7 pct
Passenger load factor 59.9 pct vs 58.9 pct
A Swissair statement also gave following details in thousands of tonnes kilometres (tkm):
Swissair said the introduction of a new traffic concept with the 1996/97 winter timetable expanded the supply of seats by 20 percent in Europe and stimulated demand noticably.
In terms of revenue tonne-kilometres, passenger numbers in Europe rose by six percent, while they rose 15 percent on long-distance routes. Over the entire network, the increase was 12.7 percent.
